newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takashimaya says to buy 30 pct of Central JR unit.
newsitem.headline: Takashimaya says to buy 30 pct of Central JR unit.

text.p: Department store operator Takashimaya Co Ltd said on Monday that it will buy a 30 percent stake in the department store unit of Central Japan Railway Co (Central JR).
Takashimaya did not say when it would make the purchase or how much it would cost.
The department store unit is currently 74 percent owned by Central JR, a Central JR spokesman said.
The unit plans to open a shopping facility in early 2000 in Nagoya, central Japan, which will include a Takashimaya store.
The Nagoya outlet, which will have a sales floor space of 65,000 sq metres, is expected to post sales of about 60 billion yen in its first year of operation.
The store will be the unit's first outlet, a spokesman for the unit said without elaborating.
